name: XCC_ACCOUNT_GROUPS
description: This table stores the groups of accounts setup by each user to enable easy monitoring of funds available balances.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the account group. Account groups are pre-determined sets of budget accounts which can be used for instant review of funds available balances.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_GROUP_NAME
columns.description: User-visible name for the account group. Account groups are pre-determined sets of budget accounts which can be used for instant review of funds available balances.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Description for the account group. Account groups are pre-determined sets of budget accounts which can be used for instant review of funds available balances.

columns.name: USER_GUID
columns.description: Identifier of the user who creates and uses this account group.

columns.name: CONTROL_BUDGET_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the control budget upon which this account group is based.

columns.name: DEFAULT_FLAG
columns.description: Controls whether this account group will be displayed automatically rather than the user having to choose it. There can only be one default account group per user.

columns.name: TIME_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Controls whether the account group displays budget balances for the period, quarter, or year.

columns.name: COMPARISON_OPTION_CODE
columns.description: Determines which budgetary and funds available balances should be reviewed and compared.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAIL_MONITOR_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The threshold below which funds available as a percentage of budget requires monitoring.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAIL_WARNING_THRESHOLD
columns.description: The threshold below which funds available as a percentage of budget is a concern.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAIL_WARNING_COLOR
columns.description: The color used to display the funds available in a range of concern.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAIL_MONITOR_COLOR
columns.description: The color used to display the funds available in between a range that requires monitoring.

columns.name: FUNDS_AVAIL_NORMAL_COLOR
columns.description: The color used to display the funds available above the threshold that requires monitoring.

columns.name: ACCESS_LEVEL_CODE
columns.description: Account group access level. The possible values are Private and Public.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.
